_doc: Minimal typed WorkspaceOperational request for xpp_create_form.
As of 10.0.25, workspaces scroll VERTICALLY — content sections are stacked, not panoramic.

Structure: ActionPane + Group with multiple section groups inside. Each section uses one of the workspace sub-patterns (Section Tiles, Section Tabbed List, Section Related Links, etc. — see dynamics-xpp:xpp-form-subpatterns).
This example shows the bare structural shape: SummaryTiles section + a TabbedList section + a Related Links section. Substitute real tiles, lists, and menu items.
name: MyOperationalWorkspace

controls._doc: Sections live under a top-level Group. Order is the display order.
controls.name: WorkspacePage

controls._doc: Section Tiles: count tiles or KPI tiles. Each tile binds to a separate AxTile + AxMenuItem (Display) — author them first via xpp_create_tile / xpp_create_menuitem.
controls.name: SummaryTiles

controls._doc: Section Tabbed List: multiple list variants, one visible at a time via inner tabs.
controls.name: ActiveWorkSection

controls._doc: Section Related Links: hyperlinks to related forms via Menu Function Buttons. See dynamics-xpp:xpp-form-subpatterns 'Section Related Links' for the precise button shape (Style=Link, ButtonDisplay=TextOnly, FormControlExtension i:nil, omit MenuItemType for Display).
controls.name: SetupAndConfiguration
